releases.body:
Initial release of OpenCode Go Limits, a TUI-only OpenCode plugin for viewing Go usage limits in the session sidebar.

### Highlights

- Shows rolling 5-hour, weekly, and monthly usage meters.
- Includes pace and full layouts with an in-TUI layout switcher.
- Adds theme-aware usage bars, reset countdowns, and runout warnings.
- Supports a configurable refresh cadence and requires no separate credentials.
